app_fee.value: The nonrefundable application fee for international applicants is $95, paid online.
app_fee.quote: A nonrefundable admission application fee of $95, payable online by credit card or by check/money order, to the Board of Regents, UNLV.

fee_waiver.value: The fetched Graduate College and admissions pages describe no fee waiver for international graduate applicants.

gre_general.value: The Graduate College sets no GRE rule; each department decides whether test scores are used.
gre_general.quote: Factors that may also be considered by the academic department to which you are applying include test scores (like the GRE or GMAT)

toefl_min.value: The new TOEFL iBT (from January 2026) needs an overall 4.0 with no band below 3.5; the legacy test needs 80.
toefl_min.quote: Overall score of 4.0 (Scale: 1.0 - 6.0) | No band below 3.5

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic needs an overall band of 6.5, with no band below 6.0.
ielts_min.quote: Overall band of 6.5 | No band below 6.0

english_waiver.value: India is not on the exempt-country list. An Indian degree counts only if its primary language of instruction is English, and the applicant must prove it.
english_waiver.quote: Applicants who have received a post-secondary degree from an institution where English is the primary language of instruction are also exempt. | These applicants must provide proof of the language of instruction in order to be exempt.

notes: Sources: Graduate College international page (fee, deadlines), English proficiency page (test minimums, exempt-country list), 2026-27 Graduate Catalog program list (https://catalog.unlv.edu/content.php?catoid=51&navoid=16082), Graduate College deadline table. Test scores must be less than two years old at application. Blocked: the SSS graduate fee waiver page (http://caeo.unlv.edu/sss/graduate-fee-waiver) returned HTTP 503; it covers active Student Support Services participants, so it is not used.
